description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PurgeService component within the Human Resource Management system, specifically testing data purging functionalities, strategies, and handling of exceptions.

classes.name: PurgeServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the PurgeService, including getting purge DAOs, executing data purges for employees and candidates, handling strategies, and exception scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test setup, creating an instance of PurgeService and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetEmployeePurgeDao
methods.description: Tests that PurgeService::getPurgeDao returns an instance of PurgeDao.

methods.name: testGetPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeableEntities correctly retrieves a list of entities eligible for purging, matching expected keys.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy
methods.description: Checks that getPurgeStrategy returns an instance of ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy with correct match and parameters.

methods.name: testGetPurgeStrategy2
methods.description: Verifies that getPurgeStrategy returns a DestroyPurgeStrategy with expected match criteria.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeData
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive purge of employee data, then asserts that employee record and related entities are cleared or reset as expected.

methods.name: testPurgeEmployeeDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Ensures that if a transaction exception occurs during purge, it is appropriately thrown and handled.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy1
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where no candidates have consented to keep data, verifying complete removal.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy2
methods.description: Tests purging candidate data for a vacancy where all candidates have consented to keep data, verifying no data is removed.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy3
methods.description: Tests case where no candidates have applied; expects no data change.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy4
methods.description: Tests candidate purge where some candidates have not consented to keep data and others have, verifying selective removal.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataForVacancy5
methods.description: Tests purging candidates who have started interviews, checking related data removal.

methods.name: testPurgeCandidateDataWithTransactionException
methods.description: Checks exception handling during candidate data purge, ensuring TransactionException is thrown.
